time_convention: t = frame / 25; frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(25 t)
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the rock/sand region (x 320-960, y 20-320) vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.025 px in every frame (scripts/cam_check.py)
camera.view: high aerial oblique view looking down onto a beach; no horizon or sky in frame; image top = farther away, image bottom = nearer (sea)
camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from depth_info + known size in the answering session)

objects.name: person
objects.description: the only person and only moving object: white short-sleeve shirt, grey trousers, dark shoes; skin-coloured head almost invisible against the sand; casts a long thin dark shadow toward the upper right
objects.reference_point: pelvis_x, pelvis_y (estimated hip: feet_y - 0.53*(feet_y - head_top_est_y); x = mean mask x near that row)

motion_summary_px.direction: walking steadily down-right in the image (toward the camera side / toward the sea), roughly straight, no stops

apparent_size_px.height_note: head top = shoulder_top - 9 px (median head offset); the walking jitter is about +-2 px; no clear size trend over the clip (depth change small)

objects.name: person_shadow
objects.description: long thin dark cast shadow from the person's feet toward the upper right (image direction (0.90, -0.44)), about 70-80 px long; moves with the person; NOT part of the person's extent

objects.name: rock_outcrop
objects.description: large pale/white rock mass with brown eroded cliffs on its right/lower side, upper right of the image; the only rock

extent_px.note: left tip at about (325,160); top at about (510,25); bottom (cliff base) about y 300-310 at x 600-760; right side reaches nearly the image edge (x ~950). Main axis roughly horizontal, tilted down to the right by ~10 deg. Approximate (+-10 px): boundary with the sand is soft.

objects.edge_px: first rows of solid green water (auto, scripts/static_out.json): y ~ 580-660 for x 0-720, rising to y~550 at x 760-800, ~500 at x 840-880, ~400 at x 920
